component.name: Qt Font Viewer
component.summary: Minimal Qt6 font viewer with a console-rendering preview

description.p: Qt Font Viewer (qfontviewer) is a small, native font viewer that links only qt6-base (Qt 6 Widgets) — no GNOME or KDE libraries, no QML, and no Python.

Its console-approximation preview renders a font at a chosen pixel size with antialiasing and hinting disabled, magnified nearest-neighbor, with cell and baseline overlay lines and an objective clipping readout — so you can tell whether glyphs such as the underscore get clipped at small sizes before committing a font to a terminal or virtual console. It also offers a glyph grid and side-by-side comparison of two font families.
AppStream metadata, a reverse-DNS application ID, internationalization infrastructure (with a Romanian starter translation), and a --version/--help command-line interface.
Migrated the build to CMake; added unit tests, linters, and CI.
